sentences.en: Abdelkader Bensalah has been proclaimed the head of state of Algeria.
sentences.zh: 阿卜杜勒卡德尔·本萨拉赫被宣布为阿尔及利亚的国家元首。

sentences.en: The law came into effect on the day it was proclaimed.
sentences.zh: 该法律在颁布当天生效。

sentences.en: The day was proclaimed a public holiday by act of parliament.
sentences.zh: 议会通过法案将这一天定为公众假期。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：pro（在前）+claim（呼喊）→在前面大叫→宣告，声明
